title: Databricks Platform Architect
description:
**Company Description**  

At NCS Australia, we believe in doing technology services better. Our commitment to quality, focus on people, and willingness to challenge traditional thinking set us apart. Our team brings this belief to life by partnering with our clients and communities to make tomorrow together.


We are committed to creating an environment that prioritises innovation, collaboration, and purposeful work. Our diverse team is empowered to make a meaningful impact with curiosity, creativity and resilience to shape better outcomes. Join us and accept the challenge of creating a better tomorrow.

 **Job Description**  

As a Client\-Facing Databricks Architect at NCS, you will be a pivotal and influential leader within our Data \& AI Practice, acting as a **trusted strategic advisor** to our diverse clients. Your primary focus will be guiding organisations on their journey to harness the full transformative potential of the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. This involves deep, collaborative engagement with client stakeholders, from technical teams right through to C\-level executives, to thoroughly understand their core business drivers and challenges. You'll work hand\-in\-hand with our valued partner, Databricks, to ensure our clients benefit from the latest innovations and achieve significant, tangible business value aligned with their enterprise goals, ultimately shaping how they leverage data for advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven transformation.


Your core responsibility will be to **architect design and implement sophisticated** Databricks Lakehouse Platform that are robust, scalable, secure, and meticulously aligned with client requirements and enterprise architecture standards. This includes developing comprehensive Databricks adoption roadmaps and clear transformation strategies that empower clients to achieve their data\-driven ambitions. Integrate Databricks with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and enterprise systems. Furthermore, you will provide expert technical leadership and crucial oversight to our multidisciplinary delivery teams, including Data Engineers and Data Scientists, ensuring architectural integrity, adherence to best practices, and the highest quality outcomes throughout the entire project lifecycle, from conception to deployment and beyond.


Beyond direct project architecture, you will play a key role in **driving innovation and expanding our Databricks capability**. This includes collaborating with our sales and business development teams to identify and shape new client opportunities, developing compelling proposals, and expertly presenting NCS’s Databricks expertise. You will consistently champion the adoption of Databricks best practices and emerging features, driving thought leadership within NCS and for our clients. Critically, you will also dedicate yourself to mentoring and developing the talent within the NCS Databricks practice, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous learning, and contributing significantly to our collective expertise and market leadership.

 **Qualifications**  

* **Mastery in Databricks Architecture \& Strategic Solution Design:** Demonstrated expertise in leading the architectural design of large\-scale, complex data and AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. This includes a deep understanding of its core components (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark, MLflow etc.), and a proven ability to develop strategic roadmaps and translate business needs into innovative, future\-proof Databricks solutions. *Databricks certifications are highly advantageous.*
* **Exceptional Client Advisory \& Senior Stakeholder Engagement:** Proven ability to act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders, including C\-level executives. You possess outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts, influence decision\-making, understand critical business drivers, and shape client opportunities.
* **Advanced Data Engineering \& Multi\-Cloud Proficiency:** Deep expertise in modern data modelling, data warehousing, data lake design, ETL/ELT patterns, and data integration strategies, coupled with strong programming skills (Python/Scala, SQL) and robust experience architecting solutions on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* **Influential Leadership, Mentorship \& Collaborative Prowess:** Strong leadership capabilities with experience guiding and mentoring multidisciplinary technical teams (including Data Engineers and Scientists), fostering a collaborative and high\-performing culture, and working effectively with internal teams (e.g., sales, presales) and strategic partners like Databricks.

  

**Additional Information** **Why join us:**


NCS Australia is where you can feel at home, nurturing your talents and skills as we make tomorrow together, one day at a time. Our benefits include paid parental leave, initiatives focused on your well\-being and discounted health insurance. You will also enjoy discounts on various products and services and be regularly recognised and rewarded for high performance. We are committed to your career development through our Capability Fingerprint, industry and partner training programs, special interest groups, and an AI\-driven learning platform. No matter where you are in your career, we offer meaningful work and opportunities for growth.

  

NCS Australia is an equal\-opportunity employer, and we take pride in our commitment to valuing and supporting our people and the communities we serve.We are dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. Applications are encouraged from all sectors of the community and we strongly encourage applications from the Veterans, Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander community.


At NCS Australia, we are committed to supporting adjustments throughout the recruitment and selection process, as well as during employment. We actively support and encourage people with disability to apply.

 **Agencies:**


We’ve got this. We request that you do not contact NCS employees outside of the Talent Acquisition team. NCS exclusively accepts resumes from agencies on our preferred supplier panel through the NCS Agency Portal. Agencies that submit resumes must have a valid fee agreement and be assigned to the particular requisition by the Talent Acquisition team. Any resumes that are submitted outside of this process will become the sole property of NCS. If a candidate is hired outside of this process, no fee or payment will be given.

 **Work rights and background checks:**


To be eligible for a position with us, applicants will need to have valid work rights for Australia and be willing to undergo a comprehensive background checking process, including probity and police checks

**Job Description**


The BW/4HANA and Native HANA Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing solutions on the SAP BW/4HANA and SAP Native HANA platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modeling, ETL processes, and the unique features offered by SAP’s in\-memory technology. The ideal candidate will work closely with business analysts, data scientists, and other stakeholders to deliver scalable and high\-performance data solutions that support the organization’s strategic objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and develop data models, objects, and reporting solutions on BW/4HANA and Native HANA, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and organizational standards.
* Develop, monitor, and optimize ETL processes using SAP BW/4HANA tools (such as Data Flows, ADSOs, InfoObjects, CompositeProviders) and Native HANA components (Calculation Views, Table Functions, Procedures).
* Fine\-tune data models and queries to ensure optimal performance, leveraging HANA’s in\-memory processing and advanced analytic capabilities.
* Implement data governance, quality checks, and documentation to ensure data integrity across all data pipelines.
* Work in collaboration with business teams, architects, and IT to gather requirements, understand business processes, and translate these into technical solutions.
* Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to deliver reliable and accurate solutions.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for all developed objects, processes, and data flows.
* Provide production support, troubleshooting, and enhancements for BW/4HANA and Native HANA solutions.
* Stay updated on the latest SAP technologies and recommend innovations to enhance system functionality and user experience.

* Strong expertise in BW/4HANA objects: ADSO, InfoObject, CompositeProvider, Open ODS View.

* Advanced SQLScript, SQL, and performance tuning skills.
* Experience with SAP HANA Studio, Eclipse, and SAP Web IDE.
* Knowledge of data provisioning tools: SLT, SDI, SDA, BODS, and integration with external data sources.

* Understanding of SAP authorization concepts and security best practices.

* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, for collaboration across technical and business teams.

* Working knowledge of Python, R, or other scripting languages for data science integration is a plus.

Req156239
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Data Scientist is responsible for supporting data science initiatives that drive business profitability, increased efficiencies and improved customer experience. This role applies industry\-leading analytical methodologies for working with large datasets to extract meaningful business insight and creatively solve business problems. Data Scientists are also responsible for ensuring that developed codes are documented into a library of reusable algorithms. Based on the specific data science team, this role would need to be knowledgeable in one or more data science specializations, such as optimization, computer vision, recommendation, search or NLP.
   

  

 As a Data Scientist, you will apply advanced analytics methods and algorithms for identifying trends and providing business solutions. This role is expected to present insights and recommendations to non\-technical audiences and explain the benefits and impacts of the recommended solutions. In addition, Data Scientists collaborate with business partners and cross\-functional teams, requiring effective communication skills, building relationships, and focus on understanding the overall business area being supported.
